▪9M’2025 , the NARTD market slightly increased compared to the same period last 
year, despite a decrease in tourist arrivals and ongoing global uncertainties. 
▪South of Thailand sparkling category decreased by 3.1 % compared to last year’s  
growth of 9.6%. Sparkling for total Thailand showed a reduction of 6.1%  
compared to last year’s growth at 8.8%.
Overall, the NARTD market value in Thailand declined by 2.2%, while the
South of Thailand saw an increase of 0.2 %. All key categories declined 
except for the water category increase of 4.4%.

million, up 9.0% YoY, driven by strategic marketing and 
strong execution that secured market share despite 
market headwinds. For 9M’2025, revenue was THB 
6,080.0 million, down 2.3% YoY, impacted by overall 
economic conditions, weather, and a slowdown in the 
tourism sector.
▪The GP margin Q3 and 9M’2025 increased by 2.2 & 
1.5percentage points, respectively compared to the 
same period last year, driven by lower raw material costs, 
price adjustments during 2024, and increased 
production efficiency in packaging to use less raw 
material.
▪Total SG&A expenses in Q3 and 9M’2025 increased by 
19.6% & 3.7% respectively, compared to the same period 
last year, aimed at stimulating sales in a softening 
market.
▪Net profit for 9M’2025 was recorded at THB455.5 
million, a decline of 3.3% YoY, driven by impairment costs 
on machinery and equipment, while higher gross profit 
was offset by sales -stimulating expenses in a soft 
market.

How the Alliance Works
Royce 
UniversalOxytechCollectors/

Post-consumer PET bottles PET flakes made from bottles tPET resin made from PET flake
•OXT buys bottles from local collectors/pickers, cleans, and flakes them to the agreed specifications.  
•HTC buys PET flakes from OXT and transport them to Royce for conversion into rPET resins at an agreed fee.
•After the conversion is completed, HTC transports rPET resins from  Royce to Punpin plant for production .
•Targeting 100 tons of rPET resin in this pilot phase from Q4’25 to Q2’26.
